scientific_integrity: No claims of independent audit or historically absolute novelty; older source published in 1991 is year-dated, while the 1993-03-22 contextual preprint is verified to the day.
scientific_limitations: Synchronous three-state dynamics on labelled complete bipartite graphs only; thresholds left=1,right=2; the all-size theorem relies on an explicit and replayable exhaustive finite signature lemma. No full published priority survey or independent validation.
title: Asymmetric excitation thresholds yield sharp five-step relaxation and two recurrent-wave onsets on bicliques
